agentTools.installedAppsHint: Installed apps load tools into {{name}}'s context on every run. Permitted-only apps do not add context cost.
agentTools.hasAccessHint: Has access means the app is permitted. Installed means its tools are added to this agent's runtime context.
agentTools.noPermittedApps: No permitted apps yet. Bind an access profile to make apps available here.
agentTools.installedAllHint: Installed from the app page for every agent. Remove the all-agents install there.
agentTools.loadedHint: Loaded into this agent's runtime context.
agentTools.permittedHint: Permitted but not installed — tools will not appear in runs.
agentTools.effectiveAccessBodyBefore: This is exactly the tool set Paperclip will accept for
agentTools.effectiveAccessBodyAfter: . Profile and policy edits are reflected within ~5 seconds. The agent's prompt can narrow this list but
agentTools.effectiveAccessTail: — everything else is blocked by default.
agentTools.noAllowedTools: No tools are allowed for this agent. Bind a tool profile to grant access.
agentTools.noActiveProfile: No active profile applies to this agent, so it has no allowed tools.
agentTools.noMutatingPolicy: No enabled policy currently mutates this agent's allow list.
agentTools.everyKnownAllowed: Every known tool this agent could name is allowed.
agentTools.blockedTools: Tools the agent could name but Paperclip would block:

adapterManager.reinstallDescription: This will pull the latest version of {{package}} from npm and hot-swap the running adapter module. Existing agents will use the new version on their next run.
adapterManager.installDescription: Add an adapter from npm or a local path. The adapter package must export
adapterManager.removeDescription: This will remove the adapter from Paperclip.{{packages}}
adapterManager.packagesCleanup: npm packages will be cleaned up from disk.
adapterManager.pathSupport: Accepts Linux, WSL, and Windows paths. Windows paths are auto-converted.
adapterManager.removeQuestion: Are you sure you want to remove the {{type}} adapter? It will be unregistered and removed from the adapter store.
adapterManager.alphaBody: The adapter plugin system is under active development. APIs and storage format may change. Use the power icon to hide adapters from agent menus without removing them.
adapterManager.noExternalBody: Install an adapter package to extend model support.

common.autoHint: Auto uses ACP when prerequisites pass and falls back to {{cli}} CLI with diagnostics.
common.acpServerHint: Optional override for the {{name}} ACP server command. Defaults to {{command}}.
common.acpSessionHint: Persistent keeps ACP session state between runs. One-shot starts fresh each run.
common.acpPermissionsHint: Fallback if the ACP agent asks for input outside an interactive session.
common.acpStateHint: Optional ACP session state directory. Defaults to Paperclip-managed company/agent scoped storage.
common.acpWarmHint: Defaults to 0, which closes the ACP process after each run while retaining persistent session state.
common.instructionsHint: Absolute path to a markdown file (e.g. AGENTS.md) that defines this agent's behavior. Injected into the system prompt at runtime.

codex.fastManual: Fast mode will be passed through for this manual model. If Codex rejects it, turn the toggle off.
codex.fastCost: Fast mode consumes credits/tokens much faster than standard Codex runs.
codex.fastUnsupported: Fast mode currently only works on {{models}} or manual model IDs. Paperclip will ignore this toggle until the model is switched.

hermes.apiBaseHint: Hermes API server base URL that Paperclip can reach, such as http://127.0.0.1:8642 or a private HTTPS URL. Default dashboard root/chat URLs such as http://127.0.0.1:9119/chat are accepted and map to /api.
hermes.paperclipApiHint: Optional Paperclip API URL reachable by the Hermes host. This is not a credential.
hermes.sessionHint: Controls X-Hermes-Session-Key. Issue scoped prevents cross-task memory bleed by default.
hermes.reconnectHint: Delay before reconnecting the Hermes SSE events stream after a nonterminal disconnect.
hermes.remoteHttpHint: Unsafe dev-only escape hatch. Remote Hermes gateways should use HTTPS; loopback HTTP remains allowed.
hermes.extraHeadersHint: Optional JSON object of extra nonsecret headers. Security-critical headers are generated by the adapter.
hermes.instructionsHint: Optional stable Hermes instructions sent separately from the wake input.
hermes.storedSecret: Stored secret; enter a new value to replace it

openclaw.deviceAuthHint: When enabled, Paperclip persists a device key during onboarding so pairing approvals remain stable across runs.
